negative_snippets:
I had one of the worst experiences at this hotel. There is no sense of privacy or security — staff attempted to enter the room without proper notice or permission under the pretense of deliveries. This behavior made me feel extremely unsafe.

The cleanliness and hygiene standards are unacceptable. I encountered bed bugs and cockroaches in the room. The cutlery provided was dirty and poorly maintained, making it impossible to use safely.

Despite these serious issues, the hotel charges rates comparable to a 4-star property, which is completely unjustified given the poor quality of service and facilities.

I strongly advise others to avoid this hotel. It is not safe, not clean, and certainly not worth the price. Stay here at your own risk.
